text.tspan: Food expenditure per person in the United States1953 to 2024
Measured as the average annual food expenditure per person. Food consumed away from home includes
restaurants, cafes, colleges, and work. Alcohol and tobacco are not included. This data is expressed in US dollars,
Data source: USDA Economic Research Service (2018; 2025)
Note: This data is expressed in constant 1988 US$.
